Entry.JapaneseText: 見つけてくれて サンキュー！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, you found me! Thank you~!

Entry.JapaneseText: ご褒美よ！
Entry.EnglishText: Here, a reward!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、サラバっ！！
Entry.EnglishText: ...And with that... Farewell!

Entry.JapaneseText: キミ！ キミの歌う歌を また作ったぞ
Entry.EnglishText: It's you! I've written another song for you to sing!

Entry.JapaneseText: とある『島』にいる『うし』に、 メモを預けてあるから 行ってみるといい
Entry.EnglishText: I've left it with a "cow" on a certain island, so try going there.

Entry.JapaneseText: う～んう～ん……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmmmmmm...

Entry.JapaneseText: 歌え！ 魂の歌を！ 奮わせろ、人々の鼓動を！
Entry.EnglishText: Sing it! The song of your soul! Spread your rhythm to the people of the world!

Entry.JapaneseText: 流れ出る言葉こそ、 宇宙のことわりだ！ 生命の根源なのだ！
Entry.EnglishText: The lyrics which spill forth from your lips are as the laws of nature! Indeed, they are the very essence of life itself!

Entry.JapaneseText: 母さんはボクを女手ひとつで 育ててくれた
Entry.EnglishText: My mother raised me entirely on her own.

Entry.JapaneseText: その細腕で店も切り盛りした。 その店をあのボエボエのヤツは 乗っ取ろうっていうんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: And even with her fragile body, she built this shop from nothing.

Entry.JapaneseText: アイツなら、町の食材屋に いるはずだ。『ザマス』って 変な言葉使うからすぐわかるよ
Entry.EnglishText: If you want to find him, he should be in the grocery store. He says "I say" a lot, so you'll know it's him.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……母さんも老い先短い…… 出直すといっても、 お金もないし……
Entry.EnglishText: ...My mother's also old. She won't live much longer. And we don't even have any money left, so I'm not sure if we can really start again.

Entry.JapaneseText: はあ……どうすれば、 借金を返せるのか…… 店を守れるか……
Entry.EnglishText: Haah... How can we pay him back...? Can we keep our shop...?

Entry.JapaneseText: そうか……やっぱり ダメだったか……
Entry.EnglishText: I see... Of course, there's not much you could do.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……泥棒とかだったら、 ちょちょいって借用書を 盗んで……
Entry.EnglishText: ...A thief or somesuch could probably just steal the contract off him...

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、なんでもない…… ……気にかけてくれる人が いたってだけで嬉しいよ
Entry.EnglishText: Uh, forget I said that. ...I'm happy just to know someone cares.

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとう
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……母さんも老い先短い…… 出直すといっても、 お金もないし……
Entry.EnglishText: ...My mother's also old. She won't live much longer. And we don't even have any money left, so I'm not sure if we can really start again.

Entry.JapaneseText: はあ……どうすれば、 借金を返せるのか…… 店を守れるか……
Entry.EnglishText: Haah... How can we pay him back...? Can we keep our shop...?

Entry.JapaneseText: アイツなら、町の食材屋に いるはずだ。『ザマス』って 変な言葉使うからすぐわかるよ
Entry.EnglishText: If you want to find him, he should be in the grocery store. He says "I say" a lot, so you'll know it's him.

Entry.JapaneseText: ユークリッドの都は 初めてか？
Entry.EnglishText: Your first time in the capital?

Entry.JapaneseText: 初めてならば 闘技場へ行くのは オススメできないな
Entry.EnglishText: If it's your first time, I'd advise you not to go to the Arena right away.

Entry.JapaneseText: この町へ来て 最初に闘技場へ行くやつは 大抵失神して運ばれる
Entry.EnglishText: Most of the people who come here and go straight to the Arena end up fainting and getting carried out.

Entry.JapaneseText: 熱狂しすぎて、 血が頭に上って 大変なことになるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Get too excited and the blood all rushes right to your head. Not good for you, you know?

Entry.JapaneseText: あたしもいつか とーぎじょーでたたかうんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna fight in the uhreenuh someday, too.

Entry.JapaneseText: たたかって ちゃあんぴおんになるのぅ
Entry.EnglishText: I'll fight lots and lots and then I'll be the new champ.

Entry.JapaneseText: とーぎじょーのまものなんて ぜんぶぼこめきょにしちゃう！
Entry.EnglishText: I'll white all the monsturs in the uhrenuh out!

Entry.JapaneseText: こわいなんていわないっ だっておっきなゆめが あるもん
Entry.EnglishText: And I won't be scared at all. 'coz I have big dreams!

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場で絶対勝つ方法を 知りたいか？
Entry.EnglishText: You wanna know how to win in the Arena, 100%?

Entry.JapaneseText: それは参加しないことだ。 参加しなければ 勝ちもしないが負けもしない
Entry.EnglishText: Don't enter. If you never enter, you won't really win, but you'll never lose, either.

Entry.JapaneseText: 望むな、さすれば 裏切られることはない
Entry.EnglishText: If you never expect anything, you'll never get your hopes dashed.

Entry.JapaneseText: 希望などない方が 平穏に生きられるものだ……
Entry.EnglishText: Those who never dream can live their lives in peace...

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場に挑戦するヤツは 愚か者だ
Entry.EnglishText: People who challenge the Arena are fools.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、 それを見ているだけのヤツは もっと愚か者だ
Entry.EnglishText: But those who just watch from the audience are even bigger fools.

Entry.JapaneseText: 見世物になるくらいなら 見ている方がいい
Entry.EnglishText: If it were a proper show of some sort, watching would be great, of course.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人の戦いを傍観してるくらいなら、 何も知らないで ここにいる方がいい
Entry.EnglishText: But if it's just people fighting? Then, you're better off out here. Out of sight, out of mind.

Entry.JapaneseText: 精霊の伝説を 知ってるかい？
Entry.EnglishText: Have you heard all those legends about spirits?

Entry.JapaneseText: まゆつばだって言われてるけど 本当に存在するらしいぞ
Entry.EnglishText: People say it's all codswallop, but there's good evidence they're real.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんでもこの町には 召喚術研究所ってのが あったらしい
Entry.EnglishText: I have it on good authority that there was even a spirit summoning research lab in this very town.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今のアカデミーらしいけどね
Entry.EnglishText: It's what became the Academy of today.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここは魔術アカデミーは、 魔術を理論的に研究する 学者を養成する学校です
Entry.EnglishText: This is the Academy of Magic, where we train scholars to research magic through logical, analytical methods.

Entry.JapaneseText: 学生以外は 立ち入り禁止
Entry.EnglishText: Only pupils may enter.

Entry.JapaneseText: 入学したければ 徹夜で猛勉強してください
Entry.EnglishText: If you would like to enroll, you need only to abstain from all food and rest while devoting yourself entirely to study.

Entry.JapaneseText: 現在、我らの仲間が ヴァルハラの魔術暴走について 調査中です
Entry.EnglishText: At the present time, our colleagues are investigating the recent magical disturbance in Valhalla.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今上がっているレポートによると かなり強力な窮極魔術が 唱えられた跡があるそうで……
Entry.EnglishText: According to the latest reports, there are tell-tale signs of the utilization of a quite powerful "ultimate magical incantation."

Entry.JapaneseText: 町の東に 魔術アカデミーってのがある
Entry.EnglishText: There's an Academy of Magic on the east side of town.

Entry.JapaneseText: 人間は 魔術を使えないってのに 何を研究するんだろ
Entry.EnglishText: Humans can't use magic, so what are they even studying?

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔術アカデミーの生徒は みんな変人だよな
Entry.EnglishText: Those Academy students are a bunch of weirdoes.

Entry.JapaneseText: 使うことができない魔術を 勉強するなんて酔狂だよな
Entry.EnglishText: You have to be pretty damn eccentric to go studying something you can't even use.

Entry.JapaneseText: オヤジに闘技場で 修行を積んでこいとか 言われたけどさ……
Entry.EnglishText: My pops told me to train myself up in the Arena, but, you know...

Entry.JapaneseText: 怖いし痛いし イヤなんだよね……
Entry.EnglishText: It's scary, it'll hurt, and I don't wanna...

Entry.JapaneseText: オレはもういいんだよ、 これで……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm fine just the way I am...

Entry.JapaneseText: 酔生夢死にケセラセラに 明日は明日の風が吹くで 生きてくからさ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm just living by, you know, "que sera, sera," "whatever will be, will be" kind of rules.

Entry.JapaneseText: 昔は人口５０人の小さな町 今は２０万都市～♪
Entry.EnglishText: This used to be a tiny town of 50 people, but now it's a city of 200,000!

Entry.JapaneseText: 嗚呼、ユークリッド 我が故郷～♪
Entry.EnglishText: Aah, Euclid! You're the only home for me~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場で胸躍る～ 来たぞ魔物魔物～ 挑め、戦士ども～♪
Entry.EnglishText: Your heart will race in the Arena~ Monsters will come and try to getcha~ Stand valiant, fighters! You'll win, I betcha~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 嗚呼、ユークリッド 我が故郷～♪
Entry.EnglishText: Aah, Euclid! You're the only home for me~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 沈む夕日…… あの向こうに星の 生まれるところが、あ～る♪
Entry.EnglishText: When the sun sinks beneath the waves, that's when the stars arise~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたのたましーも～ 空を巡って 星になるのね～♪
Entry.EnglishText: And one day I will join them too; my soul in the sky will shine~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場でたおれたあなた 二度と会えないけど 会いたい～♪
Entry.EnglishText: Met your end in the Arena; I may never see you again~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: だから星に祈るわ～ 毎日毎日、朝と夕べ♪
Entry.EnglishText: So I wish upon those stars, to see you yet once more, my friend~ ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: 大きな声じゃ言えないけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I can't let people hear me saying this, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場の裏では 何億ガルドっていう 掛け金が飛び交ってるらしいわ……
Entry.EnglishText: I hear there's billions of Gald in bets on those Arena fights...

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当は闘技場で掛けるのは 国王命令で禁止されてるの
Entry.EnglishText: Betting on the Arena is actually illegal, by royal decree.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、みんな内緒で してるみたいよ
Entry.EnglishText: But, everyone's doing it in secret, just the same.

Entry.JapaneseText: 大きな声じゃ言えないけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I can't let people hear me saying this, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: この町に空飛ぶ 乗り物があったんだって まさかよね
Entry.EnglishText: Rumor has it there were vehicles that could fly through the sky, somewhere in this town. Crazy, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: そんな便利なものなのに どこ行ったのかしらね？
Entry.EnglishText: They sound really handy. But since they're not here anymore, I wonder where they went...

Entry.JapaneseText: ウソじゃないわよ？ 本当よ？
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not lying, you know? It's all true.

Entry.JapaneseText: だって、それ作った スタンリーっておじいちゃんに 子どもの頃、会ったことあるもの
Entry.EnglishText: I even met the elderly man who built them, when I was little. Stanley, his name was.

Entry.JapaneseText: スゴくない？
Entry.EnglishText: Amazing, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 勝てねー！！ なんでオレほどの 男が勝てねーんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I keep losin'! How can a tough guy like me keep losin' like this!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 765戦765敗！ オレの腕なら 勝てねーわけねーのに！
Entry.EnglishText: My record's 0 for 765! But look at me! I'm ripped! So I should be able to win, right!?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、剣の練習は……やめとこう。 疲れるからな。 疲れたら明日負けるし
Entry.EnglishText: But, y'know, I don't bother practicin' the sword. It just tires me out! And if I'm tired, I'll lose my next match, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: 練習は勝った時に やりゃいいさ
Entry.EnglishText: So I'll start practicin' right after I win.

Entry.JapaneseText: １５０年前のウルドールの事件後、 ユークリッド独立騎士団の規模は 縮小されてしまった
Entry.EnglishText: After the incident with Uldole 150 years ago, Euclid's Independent Order of Knights was downsized considerably.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今はもっぱら 闘技場の護衛だけが 彼らの仕事だ
Entry.EnglishText: These days, they're mainly just guards for the Arena. They don't do much else.

Entry.JapaneseText: 新しい騎士団のため 人を集めようと 闘技場へ行ってみたんだが……
Entry.EnglishText: I wanted to establish a new Order, so I went to the Arena to try and start recruiting, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 強いヤツほど関心がなく 弱いやつほど組織に属したがる
Entry.EnglishText: The strong people had no interest, and the weaklings all wanted to join me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 騎士団にふさわしい連中は 確かにいるにはいる
Entry.EnglishText: There were certainly some people there who would make fine knights.

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、そういうヤツらに限って 興味がないという……
Entry.EnglishText: But they were the exact same people who had no interest at all...

Entry.JapaneseText: これが今流行りの “草食系”というヤツなのか……
Entry.EnglishText: :thinking:

Entry.JapaneseText: 何か用！？ こう見えても ぼく、忙しいんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: What do you want!? I may not look it, but I'm busy right now!

Entry.JapaneseText: 剣のお稽古に 行く時間なんだ！ どいてどいて！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm on my way to sword practice! So get out of my way!

Entry.JapaneseText: 早く剣を上達して お母さんに認めてもらう！
Entry.EnglishText: I need to master the sword so my mom will be happy with me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 山道へ魔物退治に 行ってもいいっていうね
Entry.EnglishText: Then she'll let me go hunt monsters at the mountain pass.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日も剣の稽古だ！ がんばるぞー
Entry.EnglishText: I'm practicing the sword again today! I have to keep it at!

Entry.JapaneseText: そろそろ……お母さんも 山道へ行くの 許してくれないかな……
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder... If my mom will let me start going to the mountains soon...

Entry.JapaneseText: だいぶ強くなったのに、 まだお母さんが 認めてくれない……
Entry.EnglishText: I've gotten a lot stronger, but she still doesn't seem very impressed...

Entry.JapaneseText: 早く町を出て 魔物退治したいんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I want to go hunting monsters A.S.A.P!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物退治へ行くのを お母さんに認めてもらうために 剣の稽古してんだけど……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm practicing the sword so my mom will be happy to let me go out hunting monsters, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: うちのお母さん、 闘技場で優勝したら 行っていいよって……
Entry.EnglishText: She told me she'd be fine with it if I become an Arena champion first...

Entry.JapaneseText: ムリだよ、そんなの～
Entry.EnglishText: There's no way, right!?

Entry.JapaneseText: 闘技場で優勝しろなんて…… くっそー、無理なのわかってて！
Entry.EnglishText: "Just clear out the whole Arena!"... She's gotta know how nuts that is!

Entry.JapaneseText: こーなったら、絶対、 優勝してお母さんを ぎゃふんって言わせるんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Well, I'll show her! I'll win at the Arena, and then she'll have to let me go!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日は何してあそぼっかな、 けんけんぱ？ おはじき？
Entry.EnglishText: What should I play today? Hopscotch? Marbles?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、ファンちゃんも レンちゃんも お出かけ中だしなぁ……
Entry.EnglishText: But Fan and Len aren't here today...

Entry.JapaneseText: ねー、 おにいちゃん、おねえちゃん、 あそんでよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, hey~ Why don't you guys play with me~

Entry.JapaneseText: あそんでくれなきゃ かかと落とし決めちゃうよ～！
Entry.EnglishText: And if you say no, I'll introduce you to my roundhouse kick~!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日は何してあそぼっかな、 鬼ごっこ？ ロクムシ？
Entry.EnglishText: What should I play today? Hide-and-seek? Freezetag?

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、みんな家の中で “げぇむ”ってのばっかで 遊んでるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: But everyone's just staying at home and playing video games...

Entry.JapaneseText: “げぇむ”は１日１時間！
Entry.EnglishText: You should only play video games for one hour a day!

Entry.JapaneseText: 遊んでよ～ おにいちゃん、おねえちゃん
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you guys~ Play with me~

Entry.JapaneseText: 退屈だよ～
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so bored~

Entry.JapaneseText: ドロきししようよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Let's play Knighthief?

Entry.JapaneseText: ドロきし知らない？ 泥棒と騎士になって 追いかけっこするの
Entry.EnglishText: You don't know it? We just pretend to be thieves and knights and chase each other.

Entry.JapaneseText: じゃあ、私が騎士で おにいちゃんたちが泥棒ね
Entry.EnglishText: Okay, I'll be the knight, and you be the thieves.

Entry.JapaneseText: ほら！ 早く逃げて！
Entry.EnglishText: Run away, quick!

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ……僕は 君といるだけで幸せだよ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ahh... I'm happy just to be by your side...

Entry.JapaneseText: どれくらい幸せかってね 海に出てクジラを獲るのに 成功したくらい、かな
Entry.EnglishText: How happy am I? Happier than Ahab would be if he caught the white whale~

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、僕はもうこのまま 死んでも構わない……
Entry.EnglishText: Aah, I could die in your arms and be perfectly content...

Entry.JapaneseText: 人生で一番の幸せを 今僕は味わっているんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: I've found my own heaven on earth...

Entry.JapaneseText: 君のためならば、 この命を捨てても 全然構わないんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I would give my life for you without a second thought...

Entry.JapaneseText: 君の胸の中で命果てられるなら こんなに幸せなことはない
Entry.EnglishText: Nothing could make me happier than to breathe my last breath while resting my head in your bosom...

Entry.JapaneseText: もし君が世界のすべてを 敵に回しても 僕は君の味方でいるよ
Entry.EnglishText: Even if everyone in the world turned against you, I would still stand by your side to the end...

Entry.JapaneseText: 君を守るために 世界のすべての人と 戦う！
Entry.EnglishText: I'd fight everyone in the whole world just to protect you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 昨日より今日、 今日より明日、 明日より明後日……
Entry.EnglishText: Today more than yesterday, tomorrow more than today, and the day after, yet more...

Entry.JapaneseText: 君といる幸せは 日を追うごとに 大きくなっていくんだ
Entry.EnglishText: The more days I spend with you, the happier I am to be by your side.

Entry.JapaneseText: 君と過ごす明日のために 僕は絶対、死ねない
Entry.EnglishText: If it means I can spend tomorrow with you, then I can't allow myself to die.

Entry.JapaneseText: 僕は君のために 君より長く生きてみせる！
Entry.EnglishText: For your sake, I promise I'll still be there by the side of your deathbed!

Entry.JapaneseText: （この人、めんどくさい……
Entry.EnglishText: (This guy's such a pain...

Entry.JapaneseText: 私は昔、 <Cless>の父ミゲール殿と 騎士団で同期だった
Entry.EnglishText: I entered the Knights at the same time as <Cless>'s father, Miguel.

Entry.JapaneseText: あれから数十年、 今も騎士団時代のことを よく思い出す
Entry.EnglishText: It's been several decades, but I still often think back on my time as a knight.

Entry.JapaneseText: ミゲール殿はよく 幼い<Cless>を我が家に連れて 遊びに来たものだ
Entry.EnglishText: Miguel used to bring little <Cless> along to visit me.

Entry.JapaneseText: 優秀な男ほど 早く逝くな……
Entry.EnglishText: They do say the best men die young...

Entry.JapaneseText: ミゲール殿の息子の<Cless>は 頼りない感じだったが……
Entry.EnglishText: Miguel's son, <Cless>, never seemed that impressive a kid, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとつの戦いを経て いっぱしの男になったと聞く
Entry.EnglishText: I hear he's become a fine lad, after growing through his own battles.

Entry.JapaneseText: <Cless>とも一度、 手合わせしたいものだ
Entry.EnglishText: I'd like to cross swords with him someday.

Entry.JapaneseText: 親父に比べれば まだまだだろうがな
Entry.EnglishText: He's still not quite a match for his father, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: ミゲール殿は 本当に強かった
Entry.EnglishText: Miguel was very strong.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何しろあのアルベイン流の 使い手だからな
Entry.EnglishText: Well, he was a practitioner of the Albane style sword artes, so it stands to reason.

Entry.JapaneseText: 穏やかな中に秘めた 相手の急所を確実に見抜く 鋭い目……
Entry.EnglishText: He'd keep that calm look on his face even while those sharp eyes of his were identifying his opponent's every weakness.

Entry.JapaneseText: ミゲール殿のあの才能を <Cless>も受け継いでいれば よいのだが……
Entry.EnglishText: It'd be great if <Cless> inherited all of Miguel's talent, but...

Entry.JapaneseText: 知ってるかしら、 騎士団長のウルドールさんの噂
Entry.EnglishText: Have you heard the rumors about Uldole, the Head Knight?

Entry.JapaneseText: なんでも独立騎士団を 離反してそのまま 行方不明になったんですって
Entry.EnglishText: Supposedly, he deserted his post in the Independent Order, and went missing right after.

Entry.JapaneseText: 残された奥さん、 ウルドールさんを探して 町を出ていったわ……
Entry.EnglishText: He left his wife behind, then she also left town to go look for him...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ見えてもあの人たち、 おしどり夫婦だったのよね
Entry.EnglishText: However it looks now, those two were very committed to each other.

Entry.JapaneseText: ウルドールさんは立派な騎士で 強いばかりじゃなく 人望もあったのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Uldole was a wonderful knight. He was strong, of course, but he was also very popular.

Entry.JapaneseText: それがまたどうして 騎士団を離反するなんてこと したのかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: Which only makes it more mysterious... Why would he abandon his post like that...?

Entry.JapaneseText: 本当に…… ウルドールさんの奥さん、 かわいそうだわ……
Entry.EnglishText: I feel...really bad for Uldole's wife...

Entry.JapaneseText: ウルドールさんが抜けて 今の騎士団は 統制が取れてないんですって
Entry.EnglishText: It seems like no one's really in control of the Knights now that Uldole's left.

Entry.JapaneseText: 不安だわ。 こんな時に他の国が 攻めてきたりしたら……
Entry.EnglishText: It's worrisome. What would happen if a foreign country decided to invade now?

Entry.JapaneseText: 有力な騎士団長の 後継者がいなかったことが 問題みたいね
Entry.EnglishText: They say there just wasn't anyone with enough power and influence to succeed him as Head Knight.

Entry.JapaneseText: ミゲールさん、ウルドールさん 立て続けに優秀な人が 出すぎたのかしら
Entry.EnglishText: Perhaps Miguel and Uldole set the bar too high... They're both tough acts to follow.

Entry.JapaneseText: いやー、平和ですね～ 何がいいって、やっぱり 平和が一番なんですけどね！
Entry.EnglishText: Ahhh~ It's so peaceful~ "What's good?" Peace is good, my man, truly!

Entry.JapaneseText: たまには何か起きても いいんじゃないかって くらいに平和ですねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: It's so peaceful, even, that I kind of wish something exciting would happen.

Entry.JapaneseText: 何か刺激的な事件って、 ないもんですかねぇ～
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe there'll be some big incident soon~?

Entry.JapaneseText: 平和ですね～ 刺激的な事件が欲しいですねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: It's so peaceful~ I'm hoping there'll be a big, exciting incident soon~

Entry.JapaneseText: ヴァルハラのシグルドとの戦争も 騎士団長の失踪も 私には他人事ですからねー
Entry.EnglishText: I know there was Sigurd in Valhalla, and the Head Knight disappeared, but those don't have much to do with me~

Entry.JapaneseText: もっと刺激的な事件は ないですかね
Entry.EnglishText: Can't we have some other big incident?

Entry.JapaneseText: 私自身が不幸になるのは イヤですけどね
Entry.EnglishText: I'd hate for something bad to happen to me, though.

Entry.JapaneseText: 平和なのはいいことですね～
Entry.EnglishText: Peace is really nice, isn't it~

Entry.JapaneseText: いくら、世が平和でなくても 自分が平和ならそれで いいじゃないですか
Entry.EnglishText: Whatever's going on in the world, as long as my life is peaceful, I guess I'm happy.

Entry.JapaneseText: やっぱり何もないのが 一番いいですね～
Entry.EnglishText: I guess the best thing that can happen is nothing at all~

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、ヴァルハラを占拠してる シグルドって連中、 ヒドイのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Those Sigard guys who have taken control of Valhalla are cruel.

Entry.JapaneseText: たくさんの人の 命を奪って 金品集めて……
Entry.EnglishText: They've taken a whole bunch of lives, and they're always gathering more money and more property.

Entry.JapaneseText: 一時期はかなりひどかったのよね、 人を見かければ、 かたっぱしから手にかけて……
Entry.EnglishText: For a while, they'd actually kill every single person they laid their eyes on...

Entry.JapaneseText: 今のリーダーになって 無差別な人殺しはやめたみたい でも残酷な連中には違いないわ
Entry.EnglishText: They're not quite as bloodthirsty now, with their new leader, but they're still absolutely ruthless.

Entry.JapaneseText: もともとシグルドは 国家組織に対する抵抗で、 暴力行為を繰り返してたみたいね
Entry.EnglishText: It seems their penchant for violence was originally part of their rebellion against governmental organizations.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、最近じゃ 行為そのものを楽しみにしてた って話よ
Entry.EnglishText: But lately, they've been enjoying it in and of itself.

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、ユークリッド騎士団が やってくれたみたいね
Entry.EnglishText: But, looks like the Euclid Knights took care of them.

Entry.JapaneseText: 明日から 枕を高くして眠れるわ
Entry.EnglishText: So now we can rest easy.

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドの残党が この町にも隠れてるって話よ
Entry.EnglishText: Though, people are saying they still have remnants hiding out in this very town.

Entry.JapaneseText: コワいわ…… もし、突然襲いかかられたら どうしようかしら……
Entry.EnglishText: It's scary to think about... If they suddenly attack us, what'll we even do...?

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドの残党って きっとすごく凶暴な 連中に違いないわ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm sure their remnants are an incredibly violent, aggressive bunch.

Entry.JapaneseText: 顔にもその凶暴さが にじみ出ているような…… 町を歩く時は気をつけないと
Entry.EnglishText: So aggressive, you could probably tell just looking at them... I'll have to keep my eyes peeled around town.

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドが暴力行為に及ぶのは グローバリズム化への 反意の表れなのじゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: Sigurd's violent act are only an expression of their opposition to globalization!

Entry.JapaneseText: グローバリズムはそもそも 強者の概念をスタンダードとし、 弱者を切り捨てる方策で……
Entry.EnglishText: Fundamentally, globalism is a policy which evaluates all people according to its notion of "strength," and discards...

Entry.JapaneseText: おや、難しかったかの？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, is that too difficult?

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドのやっとることには それなりに意味があるのじゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: There's real meaning behind that stuff Sigurd's been doing!

Entry.JapaneseText: 一概に否定するのは 間違っとる！
Entry.EnglishText: You'd be a fool to disavow them altogether!

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドが壊滅したんじゃと…… ワシは……どうすれば……
Entry.EnglishText: Sigurd was wiped out... I... What should I do...?

Entry.JapaneseText: いや、こっちの話じゃ
Entry.EnglishText: No, just thinking to myself...

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドは 騎士団に壊滅させられたが、 これできっと終わりじゃないぞい
Entry.EnglishText: Sigurd was wiped out by the Knights, but I'm certain they'll be back.

Entry.JapaneseText: きっと第二、第三のシグルドが 今日もまたどこかで 産声を上げているに違いないぞ
Entry.EnglishText: There'll be a second and a third group like 'em starting up any second now, somewhere or other.

Entry.JapaneseText: ワ、ワシはシグルドとは 関係ない……！！
Entry.EnglishText: S-Sigurd? I've got nothing to do with 'em!

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんじゃ…… 騎士ではないのか……
Entry.EnglishText: O-Oh... You're not a knight...

Entry.JapaneseText: シグルドの肩を持っていたら、 シグルドの残党だという噂が 立ってしまったのじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: I was partial to Sigurd, so now people are saying I'm one of their remnants.

Entry.JapaneseText: いつ捕まるか不安で不安で……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm worried someone'll come to arrest me, sooner or later...
